title: Quenched Saudi Sirloin Skillet
description: A garlicky, tender sirloin steak skillet infused with Middle Eastern spices, topped with a bright egg for a comforting, ovo‑vegetarian dish perfect for a sick day.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium‑high heat and add the olive oil.
Season the sirloin steak tips with salt, black pepper, cumin, coriander, smoked paprika, and minced garlic.
Sear the steak tips in the hot skillet for 3‑4 minutes on each side until browned and just cooked to medium‑rare.
Reduce heat to medium, cover the skillet, and let the steak tips rest for 5 minutes.
While the steak rests, heat a small non‑stick pan and fry the egg to your preferred doneness.
Place the rested steak tips back in the skillet, drizzle a little more olive oil, and stir to coat with the remaining garlic and spices.
Top the steak with the fried egg, sprinkle with chopped parsley, and let the egg sit for 1 minute to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve hot straight from the skillet for a comforting, high‑protein meal.
